fix before you deploy:
  functions.api.events[17].authorizer.identitySource: the rest api takes the token of a token or cognito authorizer from a header: set header to the one callers send it in
  functions.api.events[9].authorizer: the route is open now, as it names an authorizer of another rest api by its id, which koldstart's cannot use: give it an authorizer of rest.authorizers, or iam = true
  functions.api.events[10].authorizer: the route is open now, as a lambda authorizer is a function of the project, and arn:aws:lambda:eu-west-1:123456789012:function:shared-auth is not one: give it an authorizer of rest.authorizers, or iam = true

left out, to write by hand:
  provider.apiGateway.usagePlan: koldstart's usage plan has no quota or limit of its own: set rest.throttling for a limit of the stage
  provider.apiGateway.binaryMediaTypes: koldstart's rest api has no binary media types yet: it returns a base64 body as text
  functions.api.events[13].request.schemas: koldstart's rest api checks no bodies: check them in the function
  functions.api.events[13].cors: koldstart's rest api answers no preflight requests: add kdst.rest("OPTIONS", "/orders") to a function that answers them, and set the cors headers in the function's responses
  functions.api.events[15]: koldstart's rest api reaches its function by the lambda proxy integration alone: it has no mock integration

works differently, to check:
  provider.apiGateway.apiKeys: koldstart makes one api key of its own for the private routes, not these: hand callers its value, of the key the output restApiKeyId names
  provider.endpointType: koldstart's rest api is regional, where serverless.yml's was edge-optimised: callers far from the region reach it through no cloudfront
  functions.api.events[5].authorizer: callers sign their requests and need execute-api:Invoke on the api koldstart makes, a new one: update their policies to its id, which restApiUrl has
  functions.api.events[6].authorizer: callers sign their requests and need execute-api:Invoke on the api koldstart makes, a new one: update their policies to its id, which restApiUrl has
  functions.api.events[11].private: koldstart makes an api key of its own for the private routes: hand callers its value, aws apigateway get-api-key --include-value --api-key with the id the output restApiKeyId has
  functions.api.events[12].authorizer: callers sign their requests and need execute-api:Invoke on the api koldstart makes, a new one: update their policies to its id, which restApiUrl has
  functions.api.events[13].async: the route waits for the function, as koldstart's rest api has no async invocation: hand slow work to a queue
  functions.api.events[14].integration: the route reaches its function by the lambda proxy integration, the function gets the request and returns the response as it does: the request templates and the response are gone
  functions.api.events[16].request.parameters: api gateway refuses a request without from, X-Tenant before it calls the function: check every caller sends them

not needed in koldstart:
  provider.apiGateway.timeoutInMillis: each route of the rest api has it as its timeout
  functions.api.events[7].authorizer.claims: the proxy integration hands the function every claim of the token
  functions.api.events[13].request.parameters: an optional parameter changes nothing for a proxy integration: dryRun
  functions.api.events[16].request.parameters.paths: a path parameter is in the route's path already
  custom: each ${self:custom...} got its value where it was used: pool
